title: Purportedly AI-Generated Explicit Images of Students Allegedly Circulated at Lake Zurich High School in Illinois

behaviors.text: In February 2026, administrators at Lake Zurich High School in Lake Zurich, Illinois, a northwest suburb of Chicago, reportedly received a complaint that students had used AI to generate explicit images using classmates' likenesses.
Police described an active investigation into possible transmission of lewd AI-generated material depicting juveniles.
